sources.summary: Human Rights Watch news release (29 Oct 2025): the leaked 11th Judicial Package would amend the penal and civil codes to criminalise conduct 'contrary to biological sex and general morality' (up to 3 years; participation in same-sex ceremonies up to 4 years), raise the minimum age for gender-affirming care from 18 to 25 with mandatory infertility and multi-evaluation hurdles, and imprison providers (up to 7 years) and patients (up to 3 years); fifteen LGBT groups and the Turkish Medical Association object.

Kaos GL LGBTI+ Human Rights Report 2025 coverage (Feb 2026): in 2025 hostility became explicit state policy under 'Year of the Family' instructions to public institutions; 6 right-to-life violations (3 hate-motivated killings; trans people most affected), 89 torture/ill-treatment violations (51 the prior year, largely assembly-linked), and 313 liberty violations (~2.5x increase); official hate-crime statistics are not kept, so media-based data only.

NOTE: page body not retrievable at fetch time (navigation shell only); the underlying Bianet report covers the 31 July 2025 mass ID roundups of trans women in Beyoğlu, İstanbul - names recorded, videos taken - documented as profiling.
